name: autonomous-run
description: Run one approved task in one supervised session with the direct-use reference dispatcher, delegating verifiable slices to existing commands and emitting PROPOSED diffs only and never creating commits or attestation refs. Use when a maintainer invokes Fhorja directly after approve-plan and a BOOT verdict from autonomous-readiness. Do not use inside another execution loop, for an unapproved or NOT-READY plan, a single slice (use implement-approved-slice), or when durable resume, sandboxing, credentials, remote control, commit, publication, merge, or deploy is needed.
